scope: Reusable claim-by-claim ledger. Official facts, computation, user reports and forecasts are deliberately separated. This cannot authenticate hidden scores or every underlying external assertion.

claims.claim: The task predicts fault candidates that can inform geothermal exploration; a predicted fault is not a proven geothermal vent or drillable reservoir.
claims.boundary: No reservoir, permeability or prize guarantee.

claims.claim: DTI uses max triangular 300m probability-weighted contributions, alpha .2 and beta .8. FP is the official incomplete-reference penalty, not confirmed geological absence.
claims.boundary: PU training does not replace official FP scoring.

claims.claim: Remove exact known raster pixels from predictions and truth before all metric terms/distances; proximity to a wrong known label earns no new-fault credit.
claims.boundary: 1.5km training purges and one-cell vector linkage tolerance are NOT scoring exemptions.

claims.claim: H19 pre-gate scarp-arm weights are 92% in lidar and 85.6% in the gap regime; the corroboration gate attenuates to .35 rather than hard rejection. Shared predictors do not provide four independent measurements.
claims.boundary: These mechanics do not identify the cause of a hidden-score change.

claims.claim: Reported H19 .1894 versus H16 .1855 is +.0039. Computed selected-mask changes are 20,153 additions/20,313 removals with 71.92% Jaccard; score causality is unidentified.
claims.boundary: Account best is not an authenticated file-score receipt or controlled ablation.

claims.claim: The 2026-10-01 inspected leaderboard leader was DARD .3168; the group accounts showed .1894/.1855. The prompt's .3049 is an older figure.
claims.boundary: No live polling; no newly achieved score claimed.

claims.claim: Density/magnetic contrasts can mark displaced strata; one Arizona study resolved some minor faults better with gravity than magnetics. Within-field signed steps need not require both fields to respond.
claims.boundary: Different-region examples motivate H21-5; they do not validate its transform or effect size here.

claims.claim: Radiometric ratios may reflect lithology, alteration or weathering, and survey boundaries can imitate geological discontinuities. The pinned independently quantized uint8 channels do not preserve physical composition/log-ratio units.
claims.boundary: Do not assign Alaska NURE specifications to GeoDAWN; H21-6 remains deferred.

claims.claim: Conductive sidedness near density/magnetic contrasts is plausible but cold saline sediments and clays are competing explanations; it does not directly prove a fault or permeability.
claims.boundary: H21-7 untested; conductive-base depth is not sedimentary basement.

claims.claim: The hash-verified 22,956-row official vector ZIP has NUM str:6 and NAME str:80; its field definitions describe NUM as a fault/fold number with possible section letter. It has 3,508 missing NUM rows and 39 NUM/name conflicts globally.
claims.boundary: These are whole-archive counts, not in-footprint counts or perfect physical-system truth; missing/unlinked groups are explicitly flagged proxies.

claims.claim: All 31 channels consumed by both S2 arms match original frozen hashes. Three discarded H21-1 candidate hashes differ on the hosted platform, and neither S2 model reads them.
claims.boundary: Original full H21-1 guard stays strict; no H21-1 rescue or blanket tolerance of used-feature drift.

claims.kind: ACTUAL OBTAINABILITY PROBE, NOT COMPLETE DATA
claims.claim: USGS ComCat returned 100 historical earthquake rows with expected schema; 54 lack horizontal error, none lack depth error. This is a limited rectangular probe, not a full irregular-footprint catalogue.
claims.boundary: H21-8 viability/completeness/100m surface-trace localization remains conditional.

claims.claim: H21-5 forecasts dense +.006, sparse +.002, recovery +.008 and FP -2%; Bonferroni family size 8 includes both sessions. Previously scored geography and correlated adjacent blocks make diagnostics exploratory, not fresh confirmation.
claims.boundary: Both clean-current-best and fresh-confirmation gates are false even for an excellent exploratory score.

claims.claim: The published primary TIFF is single-band float32, 3730×3292, EPSG32611 with the exact reference transform, all footprint predictions in [0,1] and null outside; it is byte-identical to historical H19-4.
claims.boundary: Not a new improved entry, server acceptance or diagnosis of the unknown earlier range-error bytes.

claims.claim: No code automatically accesses, logs into or uploads to DrivenData. The daily feed checks only explicitly permitted official hosts and GitHub repository/release metadata.
claims.boundary: Feed health is not data completeness, science validation or a live leaderboard.

claims.claim: The inspected current H19 main and original PR-head Python are identical; the obtainable exporter reads an untracked OOF cache, with no public generator found. A .1894 map cannot be used as an out-of-fold comparator.
claims.boundary: Scoped public-source/artifact search; private or expired material may exist but is unavailable here.

claims.kind: COMPUTED FIRST OUTCOME, WITH PROTOCOL CAVEAT
claims.claim: H21-5 dense Δ+.00004166 and sparse Δ−.00021345 miss the +.006/+.002 forecasts; recovery +.00003291 and FP +.0089695% also miss. All eight fits converge; 2/4 dense wins; eight-family adjusted p=1.0. No promotion or slot.
claims.boundary: Not a hidden score or fresh confirmation; the original SW quota is one pixel above a literal 2.5% maximum. Post-result review is separate; first scores remain unchanged.
